description: Lever ATS read-mostly operations bridge. Wraps Lever Data API endpoints used for pipeline reporting and lightweight write-back.
use_case: Pipeline auditing, funnel analytics, candidate aging, owner-load reports, and idempotent note write-back.

api_key.description: Lever API key used as the HTTP Basic auth username with a blank password. The runtime constructs the Authorization header internally.
api_key.token_validity: Until rotated or revoked in Lever
api_key.best_for: All Lever Data API operations used by PipelineHealth_v1

notes: The runtime constructs HTTP Basic auth from TENET.apiKey.lever internally; no serialized Authorization header value is stored in this manifest.
All paginated Lever endpoints return a 'next' cursor on 'has_next': true. The skill iterates until exhaustion or a configurable hard cap.
No real credentials or secret values are stored in this manifest; only TENET key references are declared.
